about: The LOD tools (nw-02 step 11): Windows tools run by infra/gpu-box/lod.ps1 on the game machine, never laid into Data or shipped (decision 0014). Rows in the dependencies.json shape for stack.fetch_one; owed as rows in mods/dependencies.json and credits in mods/sourcing-register.json.

mods.name: xLODGen - Terrain LOD beta
mods.author: sheson
mods.why: terrain LOD (meshes and textures) for ARG_Province (2.W4 §c)
mods.note: laid under C:\argonia\tools\xlodgen by infra/gpu-box/lod.sh tools; official host: github.com/sheson/xLODGen releases (linked from the stepmodifications.org xLODGen thread)
mods.licence: MPL 1.1 (xEdit-based; github sheson/xLODGen has no licence file of its own)
mods.permission_summary: A free tool the player downloads and runs; nothing of it is copied into our files or shipped, so no permission is needed. Its output is made on the player's machine.
mods.permission_evidence: github sheson/xLODGen README: install, -sse, -o/-m/-p/-d arguments; no redistribution terms
mods.runtime: a Windows tool run by infra/gpu-box/lod.ps1 on the game machine (and by the installer's LOD step on the player's), never in Data
mods.linked_or_forked_by: none: a tool run on the player's own machine; its output is derived there and never shipped (decision 0014 §4)

mods.name: DynDOLOD 3 Alpha (standalone: DynDOLOD, TexGen, LODGen, Texconv)
mods.author: sheson
mods.why: object and tree LOD for ARG_Province (TexGen, then DynDOLOD; 2.W4 §c)
mods.note: dyndolod.info/Downloads names Nexus 68518 as the official host; laid under C:\argonia\tools\dyndolod
mods.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (DynDOLOD and its assets); DynDOLOD.exe, TexGen.exe and LODGen.exe under MPL 1.1 as xEdit derivatives (DynDOLOD-LICENSE.txt in the archive)
mods.permission_summary: Non-commercial share-alike: the player downloads and runs it on their own machine; nothing of it is copied into our files or shipped, and its output is derived there (0014 §4), so no permission is asked. A shipped LOD made with it would carry BY-NC-SA.
mods.permission_evidence: DynDOLOD-LICENSE.txt in the Alpha-217 archive; dyndolod.info/Downloads (2026-10-30) names Nexus 68518 as the official host
